post_edit_findings.topic: Personalization form shows only ONE field for GO#860 despite 2 layers/2 artworks referencing it
post_edit_findings.finding: In the campaign editor's own STEP 2 preview, 'PERSONALIZATION FORM' lists 'Fields from artwork: QA-CTX15 Global Option Test Artwork, QA-CTX15 Global Option Test Artwork 2' (both artworks acknowledged), but the rendered PERSONALIZE panel shows exactly ONE 'Generate image' button (GO#862) and exactly ONE textbox labeled 'Enter your full name (edited)' (GO#860's label) -- NOT two separate GO#860 inputs, even though layer-558994 (artwork 4167) and layer-929347 (artwork 4172) both reference global_option=860. This suggests the campaign's generated customer-facing personalization form DEDUPLICATES fields by Global Option id, presenting one input per unique Global Option regardless of how many layers/artworks reference it -- a structurally different mechanism from the same-artwork in-editor default-text test (OBS-019/FEAT-08), which tested the PORTAL EDITOR's own per-layer preview-text field, not this customer-facing form. Directly relevant to the sharing-rule investigation: if there is only ever one input field to begin with, there may be nothing to 'live-sync' -- worth relaying to whoever designs the actual storefront customer-value test.
